name: Training Cavern — True Excavation Depth
subtitle: OSRS tutorial-mine reference vs live Crafted Realms gameplay camera
review_note: The cave floor is now a genuine triangulated heightfield: protected lesson routes remain readable, the earth between them sinks roughly one third of a tile, and irregular perimeter shoulders rise more than half a tile. The underground tile overlay is disabled so it cannot flatten the relief visually.
verdict: accepted as the true-depth foundation for the Tutor's Holm training cavern
improve: Continue with restrained dust, ore-impact, depletion, and respawn feedback; do not replace the relief with color-only facets or block cardinal movement routes.
